findings.title: Dependency advisory remediation
findings.evidence: October 23 default and lockfile-only npm audits in a fresh validation install and isolated regression checks
findings.observation: The initial audit affected Vite 6.4.3, Electron 44.4.5, @vitest/mocker 4.1.11 and Vitest 4.1.11. The patched lockfile reports zero vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Keep advisory checks separate from test results and rerun both when updating dependencies.
findings.verify: Run npm audit, a clean lockfile installation, affected suites, desktop/mobile builds and Electron boundary fixtures.
findings.risk: Preserve application behavior, data and platform/security boundaries.
findings.implementation: Updated Electron to 44.5.0, Vite to 6.4.4, and Vitest/@vitest/mocker to 4.1.12 without changing major versions.
findings.verification_result: Zero npm vulnerabilities; 1,538 frontend and 2,198 backend tests passed with recorded skips, 145 media checks passed, builds and Electron browser fixtures passed. Full desktop startup and live device/provider/GPU acceptance remain separate.

findings.title: Consolidated current documentation

findings.recommendation: Maintain one workflow guide per topic and one dated verification record.
findings.verify: Check relative links/anchors, retained historical snapshot identity and the generated reader.
findings.risk: Preserve original snapshots, private handoffs and external app data.
findings.implementation: Merged current usage/contracts, removed superseded public guides and introduced one relocation map shared by generated links.
